story.lead: The Coalition for Conservation was founded on a simple proposition: that protecting Australia's natural environment and growing a strong economy are not competing goals, but complementary responsibilities.
story.body:
Conservation and conservative values have always gone hand in hand: stewardship, responsibility, pragmatic problem-solving, and a belief that we should leave the country better than we found it. C4C exists to bring those values back to the centre of environmental policy.

Over the years, we have connected policymakers, industry leaders, scientists, farmers and community voices to help inform practical, technology-neutral and evidence-based solutions. Our policy and advocacy work has spanned energy, agriculture and biodiversity, all grounded in the belief that good policy should protect Australia's unique natural heritage while allowing families, businesses and communities to prosper.

Your support of C4C will help our work continue to make an impact for generations to come.

Hon. Larry Anthony AO
Chair of C4C

areas.title: Energy
areas.tagline: Affordable, reliable energy that preserves nature.
areas.body: Australia needs affordable, reliable energy so our families, businesses and communities can thrive. This doesn't have to come at the cost of our unique natural heritage. At C4C, we believe protecting high biodiversity areas and prime agricultural land from unnecessary energy infrastructure is the best way to steward our natural resources. Australia's energy mix should prioritise technologies that keep costs down, provide 24/7 power and have high energy density which allows for a smaller spatial footprint.

areas.title: Agriculture
areas.tagline: Sharing Australian farming know-how with the world.
areas.body: Australia is a global leader in sustainable agriculture, ag tech, and climate adaptation. In partnership with the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and local farming research organisations, C4C has helped connect Australian experts with farmers in Sub-Saharan Africa and the Pacific. Our work has helped farmers in drought-prone areas improve their water and soil carbon management practices, improving soil health and increasing productivity.

areas.title: Biodiversity
areas.tagline: Conserving our natural heritage right here, right now.
areas.body: At C4C, we believe in protecting Australia's unique wildlife and landscapes from destruction in the here and now – not sacrificing our rainforests and endangered species in the name of reducing emissions in the future. We have partnered with Rainforest Reserves Australia to combat deforestation and enhance tree canopy cover, preserving vital habitat for wildlife.

statusQuo.headline: The status quo is not sustainable.
statusQuo.body: The energy transition is not working for Australians or the environment. Australia's unique rainforests and fauna are being destroyed to make way for renewable energy projects. Meanwhile, families are struggling to put food on the table and businesses are collapsing under the weight of high energy costs. We need to change course – and that means putting all energy sources back on the table so that Australians can have the energy mix they deserve. Affordable, reliable, protecting Australia's unique natural heritage for generations to come.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
The Coalition for Conservation (C4C) ABN 82 201 923 025 is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and disclose your personal information, in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles.

What we collect — We collect personal information you provide directly: your name, email address, postcode, phone number and any message content when you contact us, sign a petition, subscribe to our briefing, or make a donation. We collect donation and payment details through our secure payment processor; we do not store full card numbers.

How we use it — We use your information to respond to enquiries, send campaign and briefing updates you have opted into, process and acknowledge donations, and meet our legal and reporting obligations as a registered charity.

Disclosure — We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us operate (for example email, payment and analytics providers), and where required by law.

Your choices — You can unsubscribe from our emails at any time using the link in any message, or by contacting us. You may request access to, or correction of, the personal information we hold about you.

Contact — For any privacy question or request, email admin@coalitionforconservation.com.au or write to Level 9, 255 George Street, Sydney NSW 2000.

This policy is a starting template and should be reviewed by the organisation before launch.
